video_title: “We Just Need To Play More As A Team.” | LaMelo Ball Postgame Sound | 10.28.26

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the need for better team play
quotes.excerpt: We just need to play more as a team.
quotes.quote: We just need to play more as a team. We just go one shot, make one pass, shot, keep it going, but at the end, play as a team and got better.
quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball says the team needs to focus on ball movement after tonight's loss. We just need to play more as a team.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball discusses the team's performance following a game.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on adjusting to Anthony Edwards' absence
quotes.excerpt: We know what Ant do. So obviously there's a lot of shots not out there no more.
quotes.quote: I think the normal basketball thing is, you know, we know what Ant do. So obviously there's a lot of shots not out there no more, so people, like I said, we just got to play as a team. Not look at it like, oh, it's a lot of shots out there, but just stay in the flow.
